headline: IVP Limited Chairman Rajkumar Lekhwani steps down
hook: Leadership change at the board level
summary: IVP Limited has announced that Mr. Rajkumar Lekhwani, a non-executive non-independent director, has resigned from his position as chairman of the company effective November 4, 2026. The announcement was officially communicated to the stock exchange. Retail investors holding IVP shares should note this board-level departure as routine corporate governance development.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit unlikely to impact stock price.

headline: IVP appoints Deepak Kumar Jajodia as Non-Executive Director
hook: New non-executive director joins the board
summary: IVP Limited has announced the appointment of Deepak Kumar Jajodia as a Non-Executive Director of the company, effective November 4, 2026. The exchange filing provides the details of this leadership addition. For retail investors, board-level changes at micro-cap companies like IVP rarely shift the core business fundamentals immediately. The appointment is part of standard corporate governance updates.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with negligible immediate impact on stock price
